$description: iOS-only PostScript-name font tokens. SwiftUI's Font.custom(name:) needs a font's actual PostScript name (the string embedded in the font binary's 'name' table, ID 6) — NOT a CSS family name. font.* in type.json holds CSS family-name stacks (correct for web, WRONG for Font.custom — passing 'Plus Jakarta Sans' to Font.custom silently resolves to nothing and SwiftUI falls back to system San Francisco with no error). This file is the separate iOS-only counterpart; web's family-name value is untouched. Scoped to exactly the PostScript names that exist as real, individually-addressable fonts bundled in Sources/CurioTokens/Fonts/ — verified against each file's embedded name table (fontTools), not guessed. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT: Plus Jakarta Sans ships here as a single VARIABLE font (PlusJakartaSans-Variable.ttf, wght axis 200-800) whose fvar named instances (Medium/SemiBold/Bold/etc.) all have postscriptNameID=0xFFFF — none of them has an individually-addressable PostScript name. Only the base/default instance (PlusJakartaSans-Regular, wght=400) is resolvable via Font.custom today. Requesting other Jakarta weights via SwiftUI's .weight() modifier on a Font.custom instance does NOT reliably select a different variable-font instance — that needs either (a) additional static per-weight TTF files bundled + their own PostScript-name tokens, or (b) CTFont/UIFontDescriptor variation-axis selection in the Swift consumer, neither of which this token-only change does. Tracked as a follow-up, not silently worked around here.

display.$description: Brand-display face, iOS. Same single-instance constraint as product below.

product.$description: UI/body/figures face, iOS. Only the Regular (wght=400) instance of the bundled variable font is individually addressable — see the file-level $description for why heavier weights (.semibold/.bold, used extensively by Font.brand(weight:) call sites in curio-capture-ios) aren't distinctly resolvable yet.

evidence.$description: Evidence/identifier face (card no., cert, SKU), iOS Regular weight — a real static font file, confirmed via its embedded PostScript name.

evidenceMedium.$description: Evidence/identifier face, iOS Medium weight — the only other IBM Plex Mono weight bundled as a static file today (no SemiBold/Bold files exist yet, despite Font.brandMono(weight: .semibold) being called in curio-capture-ios).
